name: Murrain A Disease Of Livestock
overview: Scripture reveals the murrain as a severe disease sent by the hand of the LORD to afflict the livestock of Egypt, demonstrating His sovereign power and judgment, as seen in the plague that struck their cattle while sparing the animals of Israel (Exodus 9:3, 6). This divine act of judgment underscores God's authority over creation and His protection of His chosen people. The psalmist further reflects on God's righteous anger leading to pestilence and death, illustrating the seriousness of disobedience and the reality of divine discipline (Psalms 78:50).
